GEMSLAYER · OFFLINE EDITION

Privacy & storage

This game stores your chosen nickname, progress, lesson completion and settings in this browser. The data is not encrypted. Use a fictional nickname and do not enter passwords, financial details, contact information or other sensitive information.

The game has no account system, personal-photo upload, payment processing, advertising, analytics, external fonts or cloud save. It does not send your save to us. If you choose Share Score, your device may share your nickname and score with the destination you select.

Export Save downloads unencrypted JSON to your device. Keep it private. Importing replaces this browser's progress only after validation and your confirmation. Browser profiles and web addresses may have separate saves.

You can delete local progress from Settings → Reset save. Clearing browser data can also remove it. A project ZIP backup does not include your browser save.

If you play a hosted copy, the hosting provider may receive standard connection information, such as your IP address. This game's files cannot control the host's logs or privacy practices. No marketing or tracking-cookie consent is requested because this build has no marketing or analytics trackers; required notices must be reassessed if those features are added.

Young players should ask a parent or guardian before downloading files or sharing a score. No birth date or identity verification is collected. This notice is not an age-verification system or legal certification.
